name: Qatar Airways
note: Rating note: Owner is a sovereign state, not a state fund, and Qatar is not a party to an armed conflict, so serious rather than severe. Migrant-worker deaths and unpaid wages documented by HRW and Amnesty; Qatar reformed kafala in 2020 but remedy/compensation remains outstanding (https://www.hrw.org/news/2022/11/17/fifa/qatar-migrant-workers-call-for-compensation-for-abuses).

why.text: Qatar Airways is wholly owned by the Government of Qatar. In the years before the 2022 World Cup, migrant workers in Qatar faced widespread abuses, including unpaid wages, recruitment fees and deaths, and Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch report that workers still faced exploitation under the kafala system in 2025. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Amnesty International reports that migrant workers in Qatar are still exposed to exploitation.
